name: neck side stretch
instructions: Sit or stand with your back straight. Tilt your head to one side, bringing your ear towards your shoulder. Use your hand to gently pull your head further into the stretch. Hold the position, then repeat on the other side.

name: side push neck stretch
instructions: Sit or stand with your back straight. Place one hand on the side of your head and gently push, tilting your head towards your shoulder. Hold the stretch, then repeat on the other side.
